definitions.gloss: to abduct; to kidnap; to take away by force
definitions.explanation: To seize and carry someone away against their will, especially in a political or criminal context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{拉致|らち}された。
{拉致|らち}⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The families of abduction victims are seeking a resolution.

examples.japanese: {拉致|らち}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The abduction issue has been a diplomatic concern for Japan over many years.

notes:
{拉致|らち} (abduction) + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. A serious, formal term for the act of taking someone by force. Strongly associated in Japanese public discourse with the North Korean abductions of Japanese citizens in the 1970s and 1980s.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {拉致|らち}⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧ — abduction victim
- {拉致|らち}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ — the abduction issue
- {拉致|らち}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ — abduction case
- {拉致|らち}⟦{疑惑|ぎわく}→疑惑：13602_giwaku⟧ — suspected abduction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誘拐|ゆうかい}→誘拐：14210_yuukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to kidnap — the general word for kidnapping; often used for ransom-motivated crimes
- さらう — to snatch; to carry off — more colloquial; used for both people and things
- ⟦{連|つ}れ{去|さ}る→連れ去る：21397_tsuresaru⟧ — to take away; to carry off — descriptive verb, less formal
